verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents a real outbound HTTP callback: you pass `webhook_url` when starting a run, and Skyvern sends one POST to that URL when the run reaches a terminal status. That is a programmatic webhook, but it is per-run and covers only one event (run completion), not a general event subscription. missing for 10: registrable account-level webhook subscriptions, multiple or selectable event types (e.g. step progress, human-in-the-loop pauses), payload schema, signature verification and retry documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
